name: code_index_maintenance
description: Read and update the shared source-bound documentation/index maintenance ledger. Administrator-only; task reviews never publish source or grant editing authority. Published/private snapshots are read-only.

root.description: live (default) for shared/task ledger; published or a confined private workspace root for snapshot reads

task_key.description: Cross-session task selection is server-operator only

checks.description: documentation, connections, breadcrumbs, configuration, index_freshness: verified or an object {status:not_applicable,rationale:...}; freshness cannot be not applicable

reconciliation.description: For removed entries: kind deleted or renamed; renamed requires replacement_entry_id

claim_id.description: Opaque coordination handle returned by claim; required while recording or releasing an active claim. Never grants access.

configuration_assessment.description: Code Index configuration assessment: configured references, opportunity, or not_applicable with rationale. Current runtime values are forbidden.
